nodes.name: Intake webhook
nodes.notes: POST { external_id, title?, client_agency?, source?, source_url?, document_url? | document_text? }. document_url is fetched and text-extracted; document_text is used as-is.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: bid_desk_url is substituted at deploy time from BID_DESK_URL in .env.local — n8n Cloud doesn't allow custom $env vars, so reading it at runtime would silently fall back to localhost. 1M-context model so a full solicitation goes in whole — no chunking, which is what keeps a page-52 disqualifier from being missed.

nodes.name: Load triage context
nodes.notes: Caravann's eligibility profile + sector map, straight from what Khaled confirmed in Settings. The gate is only as good as this.

nodes.name: Download solicitation
nodes.notes: Publicly posted solicitations only. Portal-gated ones are dropped in by hand as document_text — no portal logins in Phase 1.

nodes.name: OpenRouter — triage
nodes.notes: temperature 0 and a strict json_schema — the verdict must be reproducible and parseable, not creative. 5-min timeout because a long solicitation takes a while.

nodes.name: POST to bid desk
nodes.notes: Idempotent on external_id — a re-triage after an addendum updates the row rather than duplicating it.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, rfp_id: $json.id, verdict: $('Shape intake payload').first().json.body.status, score: $('Shape intake payload').first().json.body.score_percent }) }}

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: Only meaningful for the webhook entry point. A Gmail-triggered run has no HTTP request to answer, so this node would fail and mark the whole execution red even though the RFP was already saved by the previous node. continueRegularOutput keeps those runs green; a genuine webhook response failure is still visible in the execution log.

nodes.name: Gmail — new solicitation
nodes.notes: Polls every minute. The SOW promises a solicitation posted at 9pm is scored before Khaled opens his laptop, which a daily pass cannot do. Polling only costs a Gmail API call; the model only runs when an email actually matches. Search query is substituted at deploy time from GMAIL_SEARCH_QUERY. Needs a Gmail OAuth credential connected in the UI.

nodes.name: Email → intake payload
nodes.notes: Emits { body: {...} } so the Config node's $json.body works unchanged for both the webhook and the email path.
